object_description: three-part building with a buried gymnasium beneath the central volume
design_condition: The building is placed between the stream and the road, follows the natural slope, preserves the western plot in the first stage, and creates distinct public and student-oriented outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The project skilfully exploits height regulations and deploys the building along the slope.

position.rationale: The elongated three-part composition and varied heights visibly follow the overall sloped arrangement.

positive.statement: The clear system of two distinct outdoor spaces allows events and their extensions without disrupting school operation.

position.rationale: Outdoor spaces are approximated on opposite sides of the offset elongated building.

positive.statement: The offset volume creates the two exterior spaces while maximizing natural light.

position.rationale: The offset relationship between the elongated wings is visible in plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The central body with two classroom wings offers a typological arrangement that provides a clear teaching advantage.

position.target: central body with two classroom wings
position.rationale: The three-part building organization is legible from the elongated plan and façade projections.

positive.statement: The upper ACT and ACM rooms benefit from overhead lighting.

position.rationale: Upper rooms are not individually identifiable; they are placed in the western upper wing.

positive.statement: The almost entirely buried gymnasium receives constant, quality natural lighting through its entrance opening and side slot.

position.rationale: The buried gymnasium is approximated beneath the central volume at low elevation.

positive.statement: Concentrating the first-stage program in one building preserves land and is valuable in bad weather and winter.

position.rationale: The concentrated program is associated with the complete compact building footprint.

positive.statement: The project demonstrates great typological foresight and respects sustainable-development principles.

position.rationale: Sustainability is a whole-building judgment anchored to the visible three-part massing.
